Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_intl_addr_flag varchar2(1);
 l_intl_addr varchar2(500);
 
begin
 nullchk;check_package_failure;
 if (:potential_duplicates.donor_id is not null) then
 
 select A.FIRST_NAME ||' '|| A.last_name ,
 A.DATE_OF_BIRTH,A.SSN,A.GENDER,
 B.STREET_NAME||' '||B.SUITE_APT||' '||
 c.city||' '||c.state||' '||c.zip||' '||
 '(W) '||B.D_AREA_CODE||'-'||B.D_PHONE_NO||' '||to_char(B.EXTENSION)||
 ' (H) '|| B.H_AREA_CODE ||'-'|| B.H_PHONE_NO,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_1||' '||b.INTL_ADDRESS_2|| ' '|| b.INTL_ADDRESS_3||' '||b.COUNTRY_NAME ||' '|| b.INTL_POSTAL_CODE||' '|| ' (W) '||b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO||' '||b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT||' (H) '||b.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO|| ' (M) '||b.INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO, -- jairam added this code for international address change on 06-apr-2011
 b.intl_addr_flag 
 into :potential_duplicates.donor_name,:potential_duplicates.S_DOB,
 :potential_duplicates.S_SSN,:potential_duplicates.S_GENDER,
 :potential_duplicates.addr, l_intl_addr, l_intl_addr_flag 
 from donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 where a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id and
 a.donor_id = b.donor_id and
 b.usps_id = c.usps_id;
 
 if nvl(l_intl_addr_flag,'N') = 'N' then
 
 :potential_duplicates.addr := :potential_duplicates.addr;
 
 else
 :potential_duplicates.addr := l_intl_addr;
 end if;
 
 :potential_duplicates.name := :potential_duplicates.donor_name;
 end if;
 :merge_flag := 'NOMER';

exception
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('18031');
 check_package_failure; 
 end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 l_intl_addr_flag VARCHAR2 (1);
 l_intl_addr VARCHAR2 (500);
 l_address1 VARCHAR2 (1000);
 l_city_state VARCHAR2 (1000);
 l_phone VARCHAR2 (1000);
 l_address VARCHAR2 (1000);
 l_usps_id NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :ctrl_block_1.set_status_code := :potential_duplicates.set_status_code;

 BEGIN
 IF :potential_duplicates.resolve_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1)
 || '.'
 || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.resolve_user_name
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.resolve_user;
 -- and rownum=1;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 

 select A.FIRST_NAME ||' '|| A.last_name , A.DATE_OF_BIRTH, 
 A.SSN, A.GENDER, B.intl_addr_flag, B.USPS_ID,
 B.STREET_NAME || ' ' || B.SUITE_APT,
 '(W) ' || B.D_AREA_CODE || '-' || B.D_PHONE_NO || ' ' || 
 to_char(B.EXTENSION) || ' (H) ' || B.H_AREA_CODE || '-' || B.H_PHONE_NO
 into :potential_duplicates.donor_name, :potential_duplicates.S_DOB,
 :potential_duplicates.S_SSN, :potential_duplicates.S_GENDER, l_intl_addr_flag,l_usps_id,
 l_address1,
 l_phone
 from donors a, donor_addresses b
 where a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id 
 and a.donor_id = b.donor_id;
 

 --- Added on 08/16/2011; Ashok; IM:5768
 if nvl(l_intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'N' then -- local address
 begin
 select city || ' ' || state || ' ' || zip
 into l_city_state
 from valid_city_state 
 where usps_id = l_usps_id;
 
 l_address := l_address1 || ' ' || l_city_state || ' ' || l_phone;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 l_address := null;
 when others then
 l_address := null; 
 end; 
 else 
 begin
 select REPLACE(intl_address_1||', '||NVL(TRIM(intl_address_2),'#@#@')||', '||NVL(TRIM(intl_address_3),'#@#@')||', '||
 NVL(TRIM(intl_address_4),'#@#@')||', '||country_name||' '||NVL(TRIM(intl_postal_code),', #@#@'),', #@#@','')
 || ' (W) '
 || intl_work_phone_no
 || ' '
 || intl_work_phone_ext
 || ' (H) '
 || intl_home_phone_no
 || ' (M) '
 || intl_mobile_phone_no
 into l_address
 from DONOR_ADDRESSES where donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 l_address := null;
 when others then 
 l_address := null;
 end;
 end if;
 
 --Assign address to form field; 
 -----
 :potential_duplicates.addr := l_address;
 -----
/*
 SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name, a.date_of_birth,
---- MG 8/14/99 SUBSTR(to_char(A.SSN),1,3) || '-' || SUBSTR(to_char(a.ssn),4,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(to_char(a.ssn),6,4),
 a.ssn, a.gender,
 b.street_name
 || ' '
 || b.suite_apt
 || ' '
 || c.city
 || ' '
 || c.state
 || ' '
 || c.zip
 || ' '
 || '(W) '
 || b.d_area_code
 || '-'
 || b.d_phone_no
 || ' '
 || TO_CHAR (b.extension)
 || ' (H) '
 || b.h_area_code
 || '-'
 || b.h_phone_no,
 b.intl_address_1
 || ' '
 || b.intl_address_2
 || ' '
 || b.intl_address_3
 || ' '
 || b.country_name
 || ' '
 || b.intl_postal_code
 || ' '
 || ' (W) '
 || b.intl_work_phone_no
 || ' '
 || b.intl_work_phone_ext
 || ' (H) '
 || b.intl_home_phone_no
 || ' (M) '
 || b.intl_mobile_phone_no,
 -- jairam added this code for international address change on 06-apr-2011
 b.intl_addr_flag
 INTO :potential_duplicates.donor_name, :potential_duplicates.s_dob,
 :potential_duplicates.s_ssn, :potential_duplicates.s_gender,
 :potential_duplicates.addr,
 l_intl_addr,
 l_intl_addr_flag
 FROM donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 WHERE a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id
 AND a.donor_id = b.donor_id
 AND b.usps_id = c.usps_id;

 IF NVL (l_intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'N'
 THEN
 :potential_duplicates.addr := :potential_duplicates.addr;
 ELSE
 :potential_duplicates.addr := l_intl_addr;
 END IF;
*/


 :potential_duplicates.NAME := :potential_duplicates.donor_name;

 IF :potential_duplicates.demographics_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.dm_user
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.demographics_user;
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.interdictions_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.i_user
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.interdictions_user;
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.keydata_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.k_user
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.keydata_user;
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.donations_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.dn_user
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.donations_user;
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.attributes_user IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT SUBSTR (user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || INITCAP (user_last_name)
 INTO :potential_duplicates.a_user
 FROM system_users
 WHERE user_id = :potential_duplicates.attributes_user;
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'RESOL'
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.set_status_code := 'RESOL';
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('potential_duplicates',
 update_allowed,
 property_false
 );
 ELSE
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('potential_duplicates',
 update_allowed,
 property_true
 );
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'FALSE'
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.flag := 'F';
 :ctrl_block_1.for_false := 'T';
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.merge_flag IN ('PRIMR', 'SECON')
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.flag := 'P';
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'PRIMR'
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.for_p := 'T';
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'SECON'
 THEN
 :ctrl_block_1.for_s := 'T';
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'PENDG'
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.status := 'PENDG';
 END IF;

 IF :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'FALSE'
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.status := 'FALSE';
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pb_demo', enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pn_inter', enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pb_don', enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('ctrl_block_1.pb_attrb', enabled, property_true);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 :potential_duplicates.donor_name := 'Not found';
 :potential_duplicates.s_dob := '';
 :potential_duplicates.s_ssn := '';
 :potential_duplicates.s_gender := '';
 :potential_duplicates.addr := '';
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 

BEGIN
/* Y2k checed & verified - Edwin */

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :potential_duplicates.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 



 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 call_form( lower(p_exec_name) ,hide ,Do_Replace ,no_query_only ,pl_id);
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 end if;

 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :potential_duplicates.donor_id);

 if p_window_name = 'DCWDCOMM' then

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_status IS
BEGIN
 go_block('potential_duplicates');
 go_record(1);
 loop
 :potential_duplicates.set_status_code := :ctrl_block_1.set_status_code;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop; 
END;

select distinct 
a.set_id,
to_char(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:Global.chapter_id,a.insert_date),'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi') found_on , decode(program_id,'DRUREHLD','Registration',

found_on desc
